change.summary: Add an independent client-side lighting preview with two point lights and one directional light.

rationale.purpose: Check independent source visibility and additive lighting before ordinary terrain integration.
rationale.decision_source: User requested an independent JEM renderer with two lamps, one column and sun in Sandbox only. The isolated screen and analytic box intersections are implementation choices.

introduced.summary: Add a client command and original GLSL lighting scene.

history.summary: Add the Sandbox-only independent lighting composition prototype.

notes: The preview uses client-only geometry and introduces no world registrations or server state.
unresolved: Visual acceptance requires Windows and macOS runs. Normal chunk rendering is outside this prototype.
